title: TANF - federal framework
facts: Temporary Assistance for Needy Families (TANF) is a federal block-grant program administered by states, territories and eligible tribes.
States have substantial flexibility to design TANF eligibility, benefit amounts, work requirements and services within federal law.
There is no single nationwide TANF cash-benefit amount or one federal income limit that answers eligibility for every state.
A useful TANF eligibility answer therefore requires the applicant's state and current state program rules.
